name: How do I know if I need a full roof replacement or just a repair?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if I need a full roof replacement or just a repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Determining whether you need a roof replacement or a repair depends on the extent and nature of the damage. Signs like widespread missing or cracked shingles, significant sagging, water leaks in multiple areas, or a roof that's approaching its typical lifespan (often 20-25 years for asphalt) usually indicate a replacement is necessary. For isolated damage, such as a few missing shingles or minor leaks, a targeted repair might suffice. A professional inspection can accurately assess the condition and recommend the most cost-effective solution for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Assess for widespread damage, leaks, or age (over 20 years for asphalt) for replacement. Isolated issues may only require repair. A professional inspection is recommended.
